meta_description: Press kit and media resources for Silver & Elegant — brand summary, founder biography, and media contacts.
brand_summary_body: SILVER & ELEGANT is an independent contemporary jewellery brand that stands at the intersection of architectural precision and traditional master craftsmanship. Sourcing certified ethical metals (sterling silver, gold, and bronze), the brand utilizes generative design algorithms to draft highly complex, organic structures that are subsequently cast and finished by hand in Istanbul's Kapalıçarşı. Known for its 'Future Heirlooms' philosophy, Silver & Elegant rejects fast fashion and temporal trends, creating wearable art engineered for permanence. Within thirteen months of its founding, the brand became a runway partner at London Fashion Week AW26.
founder_bio_body: Esen Tunalı Sarı is a software developer and designer who grew up in the historic silversmithing district of Kapalıçarşı, Istanbul. Her childhood amongst master jewellers, combined with her professional career in software engineering, led to a unique creative synthesis. Today, she designs sculptural wearable art from her studio in London using proprietary computational methodologies, which are subsequently brought into physical reality via ancient lost-wax casting and hand-working. Her dual practice has been recognized by the Royal Society of Arts, where she was admitted as a Fellow in 2026.
